question: What problem does flexbox solve?
shortAnswer: One-dimensional distribution of space and alignment among items in a row or column.
detailedAnswer: Great for toolbars, navs, card footers. Use grid for two-dimensional layout.

question: main axis vs cross axis?
shortAnswer: main follows flex-direction; cross is perpendicular. justify-* vs align-* map accordingly.
detailedAnswer: row → main horizontal; column → main vertical. Wrapping adds multi-line cross behavior.

question: Explain flex-grow, flex-shrink, and flex-basis.
shortAnswer: grow distributes free space; shrink reduces when overflowing; basis is starting size before free space.
detailedAnswer: flex: 1 is commonly 1 1 0% or 1 1 0 depending on browser defaults of the shorthand — know your shorthand.

question: Why does min-width: auto cause flex overflow?
shortAnswer: Default min-size is content-based, preventing shrinking below content; set min-width:0 to allow.
detailedAnswer: Classic truncation bug with text in flex children. Also min-height:0 in column flex.

question: align-items vs align-content vs align-self?
shortAnswer: items aligns each item on cross axis; content packs flex lines when wrapped; self overrides per item.
detailedAnswer: align-content only matters with multi-line flex containers.

question: How does flex-wrap change layout?
shortAnswer: Allows items onto new lines when they don't fit; enables align-content.
detailedAnswer: Wrapped flex is still 1D per line, not a full 2D grid.

question: gap in flexbox — why prefer it over margins?
shortAnswer: gap spaces items without end margins collapsing/doubling hacks.
detailedAnswer: Cleaner responsive stacks. Watch older browser support if relevant.

question: How do you build a sticky footer with flex?
shortAnswer: Column flex on min-height 100%; main { flex: 1 } pushes footer down.
detailedAnswer: Also achievable with grid. Avoid body margin collapse issues.
example:
body { min-height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
main { flex: 1; }

question: order property — uses and a11y concerns?
shortAnswer: Visual reorder without changing DOM; can break keyboard/AT reading order.
detailedAnswer: Prefer DOM order matching visual order. Use order sparingly.

question: flex shorthand pitfalls?
shortAnswer: flex: auto vs none vs 1 change basis/grow/shrink dramatically.
detailedAnswer: Read the expanded values. Debugging: look at computed flex-* in DevTools.

question: When is flex better than float-based layouts?
shortAnswer: Almost always for modern 1D alignment — fewer clearfix hacks, better distribution.
detailedAnswer: Floats remain for text wrapping around images, not page layout.

question: Responsive nav with flex — approach?
shortAnswer: Space-between for logo/links; wrap or collapse to menu; align-items center.
detailedAnswer: Use media queries or container queries for hamburger switch. Keep focus order sensible.

question: Design flex utilities for a design system.
shortAnswer: Document direction, wrap, justify, align, grow, gap tokens; warn about min-width:0.
detailedAnswer: Provide recipes for common patterns to avoid one-off CSS.
